fields.value: Experienced Java Developer with 6 years of expertise in backend development, microservices, and cloud-based applications. Proficient in Spring Boot, AWS (EC2, RDS, S3), Kafka, and CI/CD pipelines. Skilled in designing scalable, high-performance RESTful APIs. Adept at leading Agile teams and delivering solutions that improve system performance by up to 20%. Seeking a Java/Microservices Developer role in Germany to contribute to innovative software projects and collaborate in an international environment.

Maintained Java-based Spring boot and microservices for financial applications, deployed services on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3), Enhanced Kafka-based event-driven architecture, Automated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitLab.

DesignedandoptimizedRESTfulAPIsusingSpringBootandJava8.Migrated legacy applications from Java 7 to Java 8, enhancing system performance by 20%. Integrated Kafka. Led Agile Scrum meetings and managed CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Bitbucket, ensuring timely delivery of projects.

Designed and developed a secure payment platform (AESDK) API using Java and Spring Boot, Integrated POS device communication over Server-Socket (TCP/IP). Managed MySQL databases and optimized complex queries, Acted as Scrum Master, handling sprint planning and client interactions, ensuring 100% on-time project delivery.
